body.x: iCubis(www.icubis.com) will showcase English education App 'Easy & Elly' at 'CES 2014' that is the biggest IT∙appliances show in Las vegas, U.S. held from January 7th to 10th.

'Easy & Elly' is an English education content for children, which entertains the children visually and acoustically with 3D animal characters( the fox 'Easy' and the elephant 'Elly') and animation game. It features its pedagogics based on 'Phonics' which enables children to get reading and writing skills easily.
'Phonics' is the worldwide famous pedagogics originally started from America, which lessens the difficulty in getting different language with different alphabet.
"we will mainly promote the global service that will be launched in February and also Ep2 service launched in January" said the officials.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases more than 3,200 exhibitors, including manufacturers, developers and suppliers of consumer technology hardware, content, technology delivery systems and more; a conference and more than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries. The first CES took place in New York City in June of 1967. Since then, thousands of products have been announced at the yearly show in January.
